text_block_list.text:
After our outing, we still had some time 
to spare. I ask Rhein Kraft, who is 
walking beside me.
choice_data_list:
Is there anywhere you want to go after 
this?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um. S-Sorry. It was so sudden, I don't 
have any plans or anything...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good day. Are the two of you heading 
out somewhere?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. We're in the middle of deciding on 
the location right now.

Yeah. We're in the middle of deciding on 
the location right now.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, King-san! Could you hear me out for 
a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please wait just a moment!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...And that's why. I'm having trouble 
deciding where to go today.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Where should we go? King, what do you 
think?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"What do you mean by... I just think you 
should go wherever you like. Is that not 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"It's not that it's bad, but, um... I 
figured a place with a special atmosphere 
would be more fun for you too, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …………Ah, I see.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm just on my way to the park. If 
you haven't decided where to go yet, care 
to join me?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh? A park...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Hmm, I love parks, but... I wonder if 
Trainer is having fun?)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well, we got the drinks we came for. Where 
should we drink them?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah... In that case, I know a good bench. 
It's over that way!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
This area is a bit of a hidden gem. It's 
quiet, and there are plenty of benches.
choice_data_list: You really know your stuff, huh?
You really know your stuff, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I take walks around here often. So 
leave the guiding to me!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The ducks in the pond are cute too. Look, 
they curl up into a little ball to sleep.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, truly. It's so peaceful and 
soothing.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of being comforted... please look 
up.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The sunlight filtering through the trees 
is sparkling. The leaves sway in the 
breeze, and the light shimmers.
choice_data_list: You're right, it really is beautiful.
You're right, it's beautiful, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It really gives you energy, doesn't it? I 
recommend taking a deep breath here. It 
warms you right up to your core—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *deep inhale*...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wait, could this smell be...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You're in luck! There's a food truck that 
stops by just up ahead every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's a hot dog stand, and they're so good! 
But it's so hard to catch them that people 
call them legendary...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"This smell... I have a feeling it's here 
today! I'll go take a quick look!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like you're finally getting back to 
your usual self.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I can't just ignore it, can I? Not when a 
junior is in trouble.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It looked like I was just spinning my 
wheels trying to keep you entertained... 
but it's all right now.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: King-saaan! Trainer-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
The shop was open~! Let's eat hot dogs 
together!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It wouldn't be right without that 
smile, would it?

After returning to the academy, I parted 
ways with King Halo. I walked along the 
path to the dorms with Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer-san. Did you have fun today?
choice_data_list: What a thrilling day that was!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
She seemed the same as always, but... even 
so?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Of course, was it fu—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: …………Ah. Right, that was it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I finally get it now. I won't hesitate 
about where I'm headed anymore."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So, next time too... would you like to go 
out with me again?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thrilling, you say?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
! I had no idea you felt that way... ...I 
never even dreamed of it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so? Fufu, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I feel like I can go on our next 
outing with full confidence!
